coming.meta: Trio GJLS—Rigen Rakelna, Ananta Rispo and Hifdzi Khoir—and Amadeus Sinemagna: directed by Monty Tiwa.
coming.logline: Three lifelong friends chase their dream of becoming firefighters, but a reckless shortcut draws them into a dangerous mission to rescue children from a criminal syndicate.
coming.quality: Promising comedic execution, not broad consensus: one fetched review praises fresh satire, natural delivery, ensemble chemistry and convincing fire-production elements.
coming.gold: Accessible family-comedy proposition: familiar GJLS chemistry, a distinctive firefighter setting and a warmer friendship-and-rescue story offer broader appeal than an insider comedy alone.
coming.promo: High-activity launch campaign: gala events, a real fire engine and interactive bus, special screenings, cast visits, Barasuara tie-ins and first-day ticket calls are all captured.
coming.social: Uneven but material reach: ten captured TikTok samples range from 896 to 188,212 views, while the strongest conversational engagement appears on smaller creator-style posts.
coming.demand: Ticket access is visible, demand is not: first-day and special-screening tickets are advertised through M-Tix, Cinépolis and TIX ID, but insufficient evidence shows paid volume, seat fill or SAMS-local intent.
coming.risk: Conditional eligibility and campaign-heavy evidence are the constraints: treat this domestic release as ordinarily eligible under the owner-authorized working assumption, not as confirmed booking, DCP availability or freedom from fixed and promo obligations.
coming.bet: In comparable eligible ordinary play, GJLS: Berapi-Api will beat a matched domestic family comedy on Day-4 ADM/show.
coming.nug: Familiar GJLS chemistry meets a distinctive firefighter setting and a warmer friendship-and-rescue story, offering broader hooks than insider comedy alone.

coming.meta: Oki Rengga and MD Pictures: with Mathias Muchus, Fedi Nuril, Mikha Tambayong and Lolox; directed by Etienne Caesar and produced by Muhadkly Acho.
coming.logline: A debt-stricken man expects his estranged father’s life insurance to save him, only for the supposedly dead father to revive and turn the scheme into an absurd family crisis.
coming.quality: Strong comedy, uneven emotional construction: the detailed independent review praises escalating, connected jokes and the ensemble’s comic delivery, but finds the slow setup and rushed family reconciliation weaken the dramatic payoff.
coming.gold: A legible ensemble-comedy play: the macabre insurance premise, recognizable performers and reported sustained laughs suggest affinity among older-teen and adult audiences who enjoy Indonesian situational comedy, while the 121-minute runtime limits easy show density.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign: MD Pictures released official poster and trailer materials, while captured social activity shows a gala premiere and a Medan cast-and-creator early-screening activation; campaign reach still does not establish quality or sales.
coming.social: Visible but concentrated social traction: one highly enthusiastic film post reached 657,961 views and 20,452 likes, gala coverage reached 140,817 views, and the Medan activation drew 2,002 shares; the small keyword sample is directional and includes irrelevant results.
coming.demand: Insufficient evidence of ticket demand: the bundle proves an imminent nationwide release and meaningful social attention, but contains no readable SAMS-local presales, seat movement, sold-out sessions or purchase-intent measurement.
coming.risk: Execution and context risk remain: the review finds a slow start and rushed emotional transitions, while private SAMS booking, DCP availability and ordinary-versus-promo context are unconfirmed despite the authorized domestic-release eligibility assumption.
coming.bet: If eligible ordinary play occurs, Gak Ada Matinya will reach at least 10 ADM/show on Day 1 and retain at least 8 by Day 4.
coming.nug: Comedy is the edge, not sentiment: Movfreak finds connected, escalating jokes and strong ensemble delivery, but a slow setup and rushed reconciliation.

what_milo_sees.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
what_milo_sees.insight: GJLS: Berapi-Api is the lead comparative comedy prior: its family, friendship and rescue mechanism may sustain broader Day-4 appeal than Gak Ada Matinya’s darker 13+ family farce. Gak has the larger reach peak, so this is a mechanism prediction, not a social-demand verdict.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Are GJLS: Berapi-Api and Gak Ada Matinya locally eligible, free of fixed, promo, event, NOBAR or NOMAT exclusions, supported by the relevant audience affinities and testable in matched ordinary contexts?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Both are eligible and comparable, with stronger local affinity for broad family comedy than for older-teen or adult dark family comedy.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: Affinity favors the darker ensemble farce, or GJLS faces an eligibility or governed-context restriction not shared by Gak.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Keep GJLS as a low-confidence conditional lead; mark the comparison NOT_TESTABLE unless matched eligible ordinary contexts exist.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Ten GJLS samples span 896–188,212 views; Gak has a 657,961-view post and a 140,817-view gala clip. The unlike samples describe reach shape, not comparative demand.

what_milo_sees.evidence: GJLS combines an established trio with family-comedy, friendship and rescue hooks. Gak has review-backed ensemble laughter, but also a slow setup, rushed reconciliation and a 121-minute runtime.

what_milo_sees.title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
what_milo_sees.insight: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi has the stronger awareness bridge through its reported 25-million-view source; Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih has the clearer 17+ Javanese-myth proposition. Putri is the cautious Day-4 prior, not a proven demand leader.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Are both horror titles locally eligible, free of governed-context exclusions, supported by family-grief versus 17+ Javanese-myth affinity and testable in comparable ordinary contexts?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Both can be compared ordinarily and local affinity favors Putri’s family-grief hook or recognition of the Lentera Malam source.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: Local affinity clearly favors Rambut’s Javanese-myth proposition, or Putri carries an exclusion or eligibility problem not shared by Rambut.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Retain a neutral-to-low Putri prior; unavailable affinity or unmatched ordinary play makes the comparison NOT_TESTABLE, not falsified.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Putri’s source reportedly exceeded 25 million views; Rambut had no usable TikTok sample and unrelated Instagram results. Unavailable response data is not evidence of weak response.

what_milo_sees.evidence: Putri pairs inherited awareness with a family-grief horror hook. Rambut offers a legible possession and family-vengeance story, but neither title has independent quality consensus or SAMS-local demand evidence.

what_milo_sees.title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
what_milo_sees.insight: Across GJLS: Berapi-Api, Gak Ada Matinya, Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi and Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih, public evidence establishes propositions and purchase readiness—not SAMS demand. The room’s decisive output is which paired tests are genuinely comparable.

what_milo_sees.weakens_if: A title is unavailable, governed obligations distort its observations, or the paired titles cannot receive comparable ordinary contexts.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Use the owner-authorized playing assumption only as a working prior; do not claim booking or demand, and mark unmatched comparisons NOT_TESTABLE.

title_hypotheses.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: Under the domestic-release working assumption, and only if both titles play in comparable eligible ordinary contexts, GJLS: Berapi-Api will exceed the room’s matched domestic family-comedy comparator in Day-4 ADM/show.
title_hypotheses.evidence: The established trio, family-comedy framing, firefighter hook and coordinated campaign justify measurement, while demand and SAMS-local affinity remain unproven.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: If both play comparably and GJLS does not exceed the comparator’s Day-4 ADM/show, the hypothesis is falsified. If either lacks comparable eligible ordinary play, mark NOT_TESTABLE, not falsified.

measurement.comparison: Compare with a matched domestic family comedy at the same eligible sites and showtime bands, excluding non-ordinary contexts. If either lacks comparable eligible ordinary play, mark NOT_TESTABLE; otherwise failure to lead on Day 4 falsifies the hypothesis.

title_hypotheses.title: Gak Ada Matinya
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If Gak Ada Matinya receives eligible ordinary play, its accessible ensemble comedy and launch awareness will produce at least 10 ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 and retain at least 8 ordinary ADM/show by Day 4.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Worth measuring because Movfreak reports sustained ensemble laughter after a slow start, while MD Pictures promotion and sizable TikTok engagement establish awareness, not ticket demand.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if eligible ordinary play occurs and either Day 1 is below 10 ADM/show or Day 4 is below 8. If no comparable eligible ordinary context plays, mark NOT_TESTABLE rather than falsified.

Falsified by Day 1 below 10 or Day 4 below 8 ADM/show; no eligible ordinary play is NOT_TESTABLE.

title_hypotheses.title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi

title_hypotheses.evidence: The reported 25-million-view Lentera Malam source, clear family-grief hook and active launch campaign justify testing awareness conversion; none proves ticket demand.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if matched eligible ordinary contexts exist and Putri is below the comparator on Day 1 or fails to exceed it on Day 4. If either title lacks comparable eligible play, mark NOT_TESTABLE, not falsified.

Eligible ordinary matched play enables the test; unavailable eligibility prevents it, excluded contexts do not count, absent affinity keeps a neutral prior, and no comparable play for either title is NOT_TESTABLE, not falsified.

title_hypotheses.title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih receives eligible ordinary SAMS shows, its legible local-myth horror proposition will reach at least 6 ADM/show on Day 1 and remain at or above 6 ADM/show on Day 4.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Worth measuring: the 17+ Javanese-myth horror proposition is legible and actively promoted, but no matched engagement or purchase conversion establishes demand.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Either measured ordinary-context result below 6 ADM/show falsifies the stated two-point claim. No play or only fixed, promo, event, NOBAR or NOMAT contexts is NOT_TESTABLE, not falsification.

measurement.comparison: Pass only if ordinary-context ADM/show is at least 6 on both Day 1 and Day 4. Either measured point below 6 falsifies; no play or an excluded context is NOT_TESTABLE. Compare another title only when both have comparable eligible ordinary contexts.

non_consensus_hypothesis.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
non_consensus_hypothesis.hypothesis: In matched eligible ordinary SAMS contexts, GJLS: Berapi-Api will exceed Gak Ada Matinya on Day-4 ADM/show because its family, friendship and rescue mechanism offers broader audience carry than dark 13+ family farce.
non_consensus_hypothesis.evidence: GJLS has an established comedy trio, a family-facing rescue hook and campaign activity across ten captured samples. Gak has the larger reach peak and positive comedy evidence, but also a slow setup, rushed emotional resolution and 121-minute runtime.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_non_consensus: A public-reach-first reading would favor Gak’s 657,961-view post. The hypothesis instead prioritizes audience breadth and likely carry, while acknowledging that neither social sample proves ticket demand.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_stronger_than_alternative: Gak has the stronger captured reach peak and review-backed laughs; GJLS has a broader family, friendship and rescue mechanism and less concentrated campaign visibility. That supports a cautious Day-4 breadth prior, not superiority inferred from unlike social samples.
non_consensus_hypothesis.falsifier: If both titles play in matched eligible ordinary contexts at comparable sites and showtime bands and GJLS does not exceed Gak on Day-4 ADM/show, the hypothesis is falsified. If either title lacks comparable ordinary play, it is NOT_TESTABLE.

evidence_to_measure: Capture PROGRAMMING_ROOM_ACTUAL after the room across all 16 SAMS-owned sites, with NOBAR, NOMAT, event, support and promo rows isolated.
Measure Day 4 title-site ADM per show separately rather than using network averages to infer local carryover status.
Record whether the two-show and one-show title samples gain enough ordinary-screening observations for a less fragile interpretation.

applied_priors.application: Current Playing observations are treated as evidence only; they do not establish carryover status or override lifecycle and explicit room obligations.
The interpretation foregrounds site-level variation and does not convert a network average into a network-wide carryover conclusion.
